messages:
From: Olivia Chen <procurement@helixpay.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — provisional PO request and spend cap

Hi Alex / Laura,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. Attached is our completed onboarding form (helix_onboarding_form_v3.pdf) and an initial line-item export (helix_lineitems_may2027.csv). For the pilot phase we expect the following: 
- Software seats: $45,000
- Integration services (one-time): $25,000
- Contingency + training: $5,000

Total initial estimate: $75,000.

Can Redwood issue a provisional PO (or purchase reference) tied to a $75k spend cap so we can start contract review and invoice routing? HelixPay prefers a single PO number for the pilot but we can accept line-level billing if Redwood requires separate accounting codes.

Attachments: helix_onboarding_form_v3.pdf (PDF), helix_lineitems_may2027.csv (CSV)

Ask: please confirm timing for issuance and any missing fields (tax ID, W-9, or vendor portal steps).

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
HelixPay
procurement@helixpay.com

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <procurement@helixpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — provisional PO request and spend cap

Hi Olivia — thanks for the form and the line-item CSV. Quick notes after an initial review: 

1) We can provision a single PO number scoped to an initial spend cap of $75,000 for the pilot. That PO will be visible to Finance and will need to map to two internal GL codes (software SaaS vs professional services) for month-end.

2) To complete issuance we need the vendor tax ID (W-9) and the contact for AP (email for invoice routing). The onboarding form is fine but the tax ID field is blank — can you send that?

3) The line items in the CSV look fine except two rows are currently coded as "misc" with no product codes. If you can supply a short description for rows 14 and 15 we can assign proper SKU mapping. If not, Procurement will hold those under a provisional line until clarified.

4) I'm attaching a draft PO stub (draft_PO_000278.pdf) that Procurement will convert to a formal PO once the missing fields are provided. If HelixPay requires net-30 vs net-60 payment terms we typically route that through Finance; please flag if you need alternative terms now.

Next steps: 
- Olivia: send tax ID + AP contact and brief descriptions for the two misc rows (rows 14/15).
- Laura / Priyom: can you confirm GL routing for software vs services (I suggested GL-4100 and GL-5200 as placeholders)?

Regards,
Alex Martinez
Account Lead, Strategic Onboarding
Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai

Thanks Alex — noted and thanks for the stub. See answers inline and attached updated CSV.

> the vendor tax ID (W-9) and the contact for AP
Tax ID: 12-3456789 (W-9 attached in helix_onboarding_form_v3.pdf page 2). AP contact: invoices@helixpay.com (accounts@helixpay.com copied here).

> two rows coded as "misc" (rows 14/15)
Row 14: "On-site training (2 days)" — professional services (one-time)
Row 15: "Pilot configuration support" — professional services (recurring, month 1 only)

I attached helix_lineitems_may2027_v2.csv with the clarified descriptions. We prefer a single PO number for the pilot so our AP can route invoices without splitting by line item. Net-30 is our standard and is acceptable. If Redwood needs a separate GL per line item for internal accounting we can add a field to the invoice to indicate the ledger mapping.

Forwarding the updated CSV here. Quote from the file: 
---
"Row 1","Software seats","45000","SaaS-STD"
"Row 14","On-site training (2 days)","5000","SERV-ONTR"
"Row 15","Pilot configuration support","2500","SERV-SETUP"
---

Let me know if you want me to include the GL code on the invoice line.

Best,
Olivia
